title: Chapter 318: Assigning Defense Tasks
content:
Chapter 318: Assigning Defense Tasks

This man was not wearing armor, but a brocade dress.

He walked to the desk at the main seat and looked around at everyone.

Wang Shuo felt like he was being stared at by a wild beast. His eyes were very sharp, which made people feel scared.

"Lords, mayors, since you are here, you only need to do one thing, that is - obey orders."

"In the next action, I hope you can strictly obey the combat orders."

After saying that, he glanced at everyone again, his eyes full of coldness that could not be questioned.

Everyone present did not disobey his orders.

After waiting for a long time, he continued: "This time you can support Shanhai City. On behalf of the Lord of Shanhai City, I thank you all. When the war starts, the system will open a military merit point system. This time, in addition to the system rewards, Zhao Junshou also prepared generous rewards for the mayors and lords on the list."

"We are responsible for defending the East Gate,..."

Sauron gave a brief introduction to the specific combat situation.

When fighting in Shanhai City, there is no need to worry about being attacked by the dead air, because there is a formation to protect it.

Moreover, Shanhai City will provide a large amount of defensive supplies, and everyone can go to the quartermaster at the East Gate to collect them.

At the same time, you can also exchange some equipment and skills with military merits...

Wang Shuo thought to himself, this really moved the set of the ancient battlefield here.

After the combat meeting, Wang Shuo went to the quartermaster to check it out.

Gold-level weapons and armors are available on it. These things are still very helpful for some generals, especially those lords who have many generals but insufficient equipment.

Among them, there are some rare weapons that make Wang Shuo very excited, but the military merit points exchanged are also astonishing.

At the same time, each lord has some free city defense supplies, such as kerosene, arrows, etc.

The part exceeding the quota needs to be exchanged by the lords with military merit points. After all, more supplies mean more military merit points.

After arranging the combat area, Wang Shuo was able to successfully climb the city wall.

Walk up the 30-meter-high city wall from the horse path.

Overlooking Shanhai City.

Countless houses are crisscrossed, like small grids.

Standing on the city wall, looking into the distance.

It can be vaguely seen that a layer of transparent light curtain wraps up the entire Shanhai City along the city wall, like an upside-down pot lid.

3 kilometers away, countless skeleton troops are stationed. One of the altars is huge, and it is filled with extremely strong death energy, as if summoning some terrible monster.

In other places, there are a large number of altars, with black smoke rising up.

But, if you look closely, it is not black smoke, but the thick black death energy flowing from top to bottom.

The death energy gathers into a tornado-like smoke column, standing on the altar, like a "pillar supporting the sky".

The dark clouds and death in the sky were indistinguishable. Under the vast sky, countless columns of death smoke connected the sky and the earth. Countless skeletons on the ground, with hollow chests, emitted fiery red light.

A scene of hell.

If it weren't for this gloomy tone, it would really feel like a lonely smoke in the desert.

Wang Shuo looked at the battlements and found that this kind of wall bricks was more solid than the bronze bricks in Wana Town.

"Silver-level wall bricks?"

Wang Shuo couldn't help but guess that the bricks were silver-white, and each piece was about the same size as a bronze brick.

The width of the wall was also more than ten meters wide, and it was even wider at the raised horse face of the wall, with many arrow towers standing on it.

And the city wall at the gate was also huge.

What Wang Shuo needed to defend was the wall between the four horse faces, a total of 4 kilometers, close to the city wall.

As for the most important city wall, of course, it was defended by the main force of the Xuanjia Army of Shanhai City.

Wang Shuo finally saw the Xuanjia Army led by Sauron.

Each of them is level 60, tall, wearing black armor, and looks majestic.

Wang Shuo led his soldiers to the designated defense area, and the Black Armor Army began to gather towards the city wall.

Wang Shuo only needs 10,000 people to defend this section of the city wall, and the extra people can be rotated and replaced.

When the real siege begins, the casualties will inevitably be very serious, so the reserve soldiers must be prepared in sufficient quantities.
